# Exact values for many columns and few rows

Generated by `scripts/small_formulas_data.py md`; do not edit.

Exact `t_{n,m}(G)` for `n <= 12` and `13 <= m <= min(32, 2^n)`. With `N = 2^n` and `r = N - m`,
the closed forms of the article give the excess `t - C(m)` near the complete cube; the other pairs come from
the path formula (`data/gradient-bound/exact_formula.csv`).

## Closed forms

- `r <= n`: `t - C(m) = 0` (Proposition dense);
- `r = n + 1`, `n >= 3`: `t - C(m) = N / (m binom(N, n+1))`;
- `r = n + 2`, `n >= 4`: `t - C(m) = 2^(n-2) (3^n - 2n - 1) / (m binom(N, n+2))` (Proposition near-dense).
